newsitem.title: USA: U.S. LPGs mostly higher in thin trade as NYMEX soars - May 12.
newsitem.headline: U.S. LPGs mostly higher in thin trade as NYMEX soars - May 12.

text.p: Most U.S. liquefied petroleum gas prices firmed in light trade Monday afternoon tracking sharply higher NYMEX crude futures prices in a market characterized by hesistancy, traders said.
"It was cautious buying. People just want what they really need," one Houston trader said.
"There's not much speculation in this market," he said.
Propane prices in Mont Belvieu, Texas were about steady at 35/35.25 cents a gallon, with one parcel sold in the early going at 37.75 cents before the sharp futures move made LPG traders take pause.
Propane values at Conway, Kansas were talked higher in the afternoon at about 36.50 cents a gallon, traders said.
